title: LLM inference cost: cheaper tokens, bigger bills
takeaways: Like-for-like inference cost falls about 10x a year (a16z)
Enterprise AI spend hit $176.8 billion, up 5.4x (Menlo)
Agents generate 80% of tokens; agent use grew 37x (Menlo)
IndiaAI compute: about ₹65 per GPU hour (Business Standard)
source_note: Sources: Stanford HAI 2025; a16z; Menlo Ventures 2026; Business Standard 2026
